answer: A newcomer earns weight only after finishing a sequential delay puzzle that takes one hour of wall-clock time and cannot be split across machines. A second node must mirror the same computation and compare the result, so a shortcut is caught before any weight accrues; each fake must cross an atlas of 12 timed checkpoints in order, and if one is caught copying, its standing falls to nadir and the hour restarts from zero. Running 100 fakes therefore costs 100 unshareable hours, plus a fresh hour for every clone caught cheating.
